verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the DGX B200's management stack can plausibly do event-driven automation, and the docs mention active health monitoring with automatic system alerts plus BMC support for Redfish/IPMI/SNMP. Those alerts are event-triggered actions, but nothing shows users can define their own rules or trigger arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: user-definable rule/policy configuration, custom triggered actions beyond alerts, documentation of event types and rule syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.
